name: 芒果TV
description: 分组 partM · 上游 fmz200/wool_scripts
text:
#!name=芒果TV
#!desc=某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思
#!homepage=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts
#!icon=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/icons/gif/naisi-01.gif
#!raw-url=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/raw/main/Loon/plugin/split/partM/MangoTV.lpx
#!tg-channel=https://t.me/inaisi
#!date=2026-11-11 21:17:23
#############################################


[Argument]
mhgotv_enable = switch,true,false,tag=芒果TV-脚本开关

[Rule]
DOMAIN, dflow.bz.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, encounter.bz.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, floor.bz.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, img.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, layer.bz.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, mob.bz.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, mobile.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, rc-topic-api.bz.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, v2.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, video.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, vip.bz.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN, ys.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,mobile2.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,cdn.cmop.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,cmop.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,imgaliyun.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,imgaliyun.res.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,m2.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,mobaliyun.res.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,pc.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,pc1.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,pcvideoaliyun.titan.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,pcvideoyd.titan.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,pcweb.v1.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,py.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,web.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,x.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,y.da.mgtv.com, REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX,da.mgtv.com, REJECT



[Rewrite]
# 无用请求
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/[\d\.]+:\d{5}\/\?cmd=indexes/i then reject(404)
# 首页左上角推广
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/[\d\.]+\/odin\/c1\/(channel\/ads|skin\/config)\?/i then reject_dict(200)
# 底部tab红点
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/damang\.api\.mgtv\.com\/station\/album\/red\/dot\?/i then reject_dict(200)
# 播放器界面
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/hb-boom\.api\.mgtv\.com\/release\/pullReleaseInfo/i then reject_dict(200)
# 升级弹窗
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mobile\.api\.mgtv\.com\/v2\/mobile\/checkUpdate\?/i then reject_dict(200)
# 搜索框填充词
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mobileso\.bz\.mgtv\.com\/spotlight\/search\/v1\?/i then reject_dict(200)


[Script]
# 我的页面
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/me\.bz\.mgtv\.com\/v3\/module\/list\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/cnftp.js") with enable=${mhgotv_enable}, tag="芒果TV我的页面", timeout=60, requires_body=true
# 首页信息流,顶部tab
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mob-st\.bz\.mgtv\.com\/odin\/c1\/channel\/index\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/cnftp.js") with enable=${mhgotv_enable}, tag="芒果TV首页信息流", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/dc2?\.bz\.mgtv\.com\/dynamic\/v1\/channel\/(index|vrsList)\/\w/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/cnftp.js") with enable=${mhgotv_enable}, tag="芒果TV", timeout=60, requires_body=true
# 底部tab
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mobile\.api\.mgtv\.com\/mobile\/config\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/cnftp.js") with enable=${mhgotv_enable}, tag="芒果TV底部tab", timeout=60, requires_body=true
# 播放详情页
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mobile\.api\.mgtv\.com\/v10\/video\/info\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/cnftp.js") with enable=${mhgotv_enable}, tag="芒果TV播放详情页", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mobile-thor\.api\.mgtv\.com\/v1\/vod\/info\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/cnftp.js") with enable=${mhgotv_enable}, tag="芒果TV播放详情页", timeout=60, requires_body=true
# 搜索框填充词
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mobileso\.bz\.mgtv\.com\/mobile\/recommend\/v2\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/cnftp.js") with enable=${mhgotv_enable}, tag="芒果TV搜索框填充词", timeout=60, requires_body=true


[MITM]
hostname = *.mgtv.com
